devnet_7_status.highlight: DevNet 7 stable; no finality stalls recently; Prysm sync stall being investigated/fixed
Toni's attack: flooding network with thousands of 9.5 MB signed payloads causes missed slots; Lighthouse repropagating envelopes it already saw (fix incoming for DevNet 8)
Root cause: missing IGNORE rule for duplicate SignedExecutionPayloadEnvelope per builder; in spec but not implemented by all clients

devnet_8_planning.highlight: Repricing numbers for DevNet 8 not yet confirmed final; running benchmarks on mainnet-representative state to verify; decision expected by ACDE
DevNet 8 (Platåberget) is public-facing testnet; repricing must be final before launch to avoid second repricing on public network
Stefan proposes ~70 MB genesis SSZ state in DevNet 8 to retest SSZ encoding issues from DevNet 7; general consensus to proceed
Barnabas requests optional SNAP2 and stateful deltas testing on DevNet 8; EIP-8136 and EIP-8189 shared in chat

gas_limit_bump.highlight: Proposal: bump default gas limit to 200M at Glamsterdam fork to prevent pre-fork transactions failing post-repricing
CL clients pushed back: enabling 200M in Glamsterdam release risks triggering pre-fork; requires effectively two gas limit flags
No resolution; Barnabas to draft a proposal that avoids requiring two client releases without dual-flag complexity

eip_8070.highlight: EIP-8070 last-call for objections; none raised; confirmed mandatory for DevNet 8

circuit_breaker_updates.highlight: Teku circuit breaker implemented and in DevNet 8 branch; enabled by default but values too permissive; Mehdi to share tighter config flags
Nimbus circuit breaker: porting existing Fusaka design to payloads; no Lighthouse rep present to give update

action_items.action: Toni to write up payload-flooding attack and retest on DevNet 8; notify all clients when starting so they can capture live profiles
Approve EIPs/pull/12021 to unblock EIP-8282 updates for Glamsterdam

decisions.decision: Payload-flooding retest deferred to DevNet 8 (not DevNet 7); spec fix for duplicate envelope IGNORE rule to be implemented by affected clients
Delay DevNet 8 launch until ACDE; repricing numbers must be confirmed final first
EIP-8070 mandatory for DevNet 8; no objections raised

targets.target: ACDE (this week): confirm or revise Glamsterdam repricing numbers
